plain.title: Ironvellum connector
plain.reload: Reload your AI client to use the new folders.
plain.session_problem: Some session activity could not be checked.
plain.refresh_failed: New file could not be loaded
plain.no_loaded: No running session has loaded training yet.
plain.check_file: Check the folders and finish copying a supported Ironvellum export, then try again.
plain.check_settings: Check the settings file and folder access, then try again.
plain.transfer: Copy an Ironvellum training export from your phone into the training inbox.
plain.different_source: This is a different training source
plain.choose_source_help: Choose which training your AI should use.
plain.existing_drafts: Existing drafts keep the training source they were created from.
plain.selection_failed: This training file is no longer available. Reopen the source choice to check again.
plain.no_drafts: No drafts in this folder yet.
plain.drafts_problem: Drafts could not be checked. Check access and the files in the drafts folder.
plain.agent_hint: Ask your agent to connect Ironvellum.
plain.local: Runs locally · No Ironvellum account required
plain.watch_help: Load new valid files from the chosen dataset.
plain.watch_off: With watching off, a running session keeps its training. Restart your AI client or explicitly choose a source to load another validated file.
plain.saved: Settings saved. Use your agent to set up or reload the AI client if needed.
plain.settings_failed: Could not save settings. Choose separate training and drafts folders and check folder access.
plain.folder_failed: Could not open the folder. Check its location in Manual settings.
plain.gui_unavailable: The desktop window is unavailable. Use status --help or setup --help.
plain.agent_request: Set up my local Ironvellum connector with the native ironvellum-connector executable. Ask which folders and AI client to use. Preserve my other settings. Verify initialization, tool listing and read-only training status, then tell me if I need to reload my client or transfer a file. Use a verified source for the executable.
plain.tagline: Your training. Your AI. Your files.
plain.loaded_help: This connector session has loaded the training below.
plain.disconnected: No AI client is currently connected.
plain.updated: Automatic loading is enabled in settings.
plain.transfer_footer: You choose how to move files between your phone and computer.
plain.folders_help: Choose the folders used on this computer.
plain.reconnect: Changing folders requires your AI to reconnect.
plain.last_valid: Still using your last valid training
plain.archive_found: A different training archive was found. Choose which one your AI should use.
plain.transfer_help: Share a training file from Ironvellum, then place it in your exports folder.
plain.unreadable: New file could not be read
plain.retry_retained: Copy the file again, then retry. This session still has the previous training loaded.
plain.settings_changed: Settings changed. Reopen Manual settings to review the current folders.
plain.reveal_requested: Requested the draft’s location in your file manager.
